Copied from auth.quantt.ca (same files) for headshot cropping on the profile page (lib/headshot-crop.ts), so it needs no outside CDN.
- `vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.*`: npm `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14` (Apache-2.0, Google).
- `blaze_face_short_range.tflite`: MediaPipe BlazeFace short-range face detector (Apache-2.0),
  https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_detector/blaze_face_short_range/float16/1/blaze_face_short_range.tflite
